question.text: An analyst employed by a research entity shall NOT be subject to supervision or control of:

answer.text: Any employee of the merchant banking, investment banking, or brokerage services divisions
The CEO of the research entity

explanation.text: The Logic: Regulation 17(4), as set out on page 277 of the NISM XV workbook, states that an individual employed as a research analyst shall not be subject to the supervision or control of any employee of the merchant banking, investment banking or brokerage services divisions. The independence mechanism is described on page 276. The Trap: The rule is a prohibition on supervision by IB/MB/brokerage staff. The workbook does not affirmatively designate any specific alternative supervisor or reporting line, so the other options should not be treated as endorsed supervisors. Note: Source-backed by Regulation 17(4) on page 277 of NISM Series XV Research Analyst Workbook (February 2026).
